resolved.title: 欢迎学SQL
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Welcome to SQL[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]database [/b]is a collection of data that is organized in a manner that facilitates ease of access, as well as efficient management and updating. 

A database is made up of [b]tables [/b]that store relevant information. 

For example, you would use a database, if you were to create a website like YouTube, which contains a lot of information like videos, usernames, passwords, comments. [img id="2785" width="100%"]
[note]In this course we will learn how to create and query databases using SQL![/note]

content.text:
**数据库**(database)是数据的集合，其组织存储数据的方式有利于方访问、管理和更新数据。

一个数据库是由储存相关信息的**表**(**table**)组成的。

例如，如果你要创建一个普通的视频网站(如B站)，则会使用数据库存储大量的信息，如视频(videos)、用户（users）、评论（comments)。

resolved.title: 数据库及表
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Database Tables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A table stores and displays data in a structured format consisting of [b]columns [/b]and [b]rows [/b]that are similar to those seen in Excel spreadsheets. 

Databases often contain multiple tables, each designed for a specific purpose. For example, imagine creating a database table of [b]names[/b] and [b]telephone numbers[/b]. 

First, we would set up columns with the titles [i]FirstName[/i], [i]LastName [/i]and [i]TelephoneNumber[/i]. 

Each table includes its own set of fields, based on the data it will store. [img id="2787" width="100%"]
[note]A table has a specified number of columns but can have any number of rows.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Database Tables[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Databases often contain multiple tables, each designed for a specific purpose. For example, imagine creating a database table of [b]names[/b] and [b]telephone numbers[/b]. 

First, we would set up columns with the titles [i]FirstName[/i], [i]LastName [/i]and [i]TelephoneNumber[/i]. 

Each table includes its own set of fields, based on the data it will store. [img id="2787" width="100%"]
[note]A table has a specified number of columns but can have any number of rows.[/note]

content.text:
**表**(table)以结构化的方式存储和显示数据，和Excel电子表格类似，由**列**(column)和**行**(row)组成.

数据库通常包含多个表，每个表都为特定目的而设计。例如，想象一下创建一个包含**姓名**和**电话号码**的表。

首先，我们将设置三列：
- **FirstName**: 姓
- **LastName**: 名
- **TelephoneNumber**: 电话号码

每个表基于它本身的功能，都有特定的字段集（此处字段即为列）。
content.text_html:
A table stores and displays data in a structured format consisting of **columns **and **rows **that are similar to those seen in Excel spreadsheets.

Databases often contain multiple tables, each designed for a specific purpose. For example, imagine creating a database table of names and telephone numbers.

First, we would set up columns with the titles FirstName, *LastName *and TelephoneNumber.

Each table includes its own set of fields, based on the data it will store.

表以结构化格式存储和显示数据，由列和行组成，与Excel电子表格中的数据相似。

数据库通常包含多个表，每个表都为特定目的而设计。例如，想象一下创建一个姓名和电话号码的数据库表。

首先，我们将设置标题为名、姓和电话号的列。

每个表都包括自己的字段集，基于它要存储的数据。

resolved.title: 主键 Primary Key
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Primary Keys[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A primary key is a field in the table that uniquely identifies the table records. 

The primary key's main features:
- It must contain a [b]unique value[/b] for each row.
- It cannot contain [b]NULL[/b] values.

For example, our table contains a record for each name in a phone book. The unique [b]ID [/b]number would be a good choice for a primary key in the table, as there is always the chance for more than one person to have the same name. [img id="2788" width="100%"]
[note]- Tables are limited to [b]ONE [/b]primary key each.
- The primary key's value must be different for each row.[/note]
resolved.description_en:

content.text:
**主键**(Primary Key)是表中的一个字段，可以唯一地识别表中的每一行记录。

主键的核心特点：
- 每一行必须有**唯一**的主键值，不可重复。
- 不能包含**NULL**值。

例如，我们的表中包含每个好友的信息，但姓名并不适合作为主键，因为可能两个好友可能有相同的姓名。

但可以对每个好友人进行数字编码，如自增的数字**ID**号则会是该表主键的一个很好的选择。
content.text_html:
A primary key is a field in the table that uniquely identifies the table records.

The primary key's main features:

  • It must contain a unique value for each row.
  • It cannot contain NULL values.

For example, our table contains a record for each name in a phone book. The unique **ID **number would be a good choice for a primary key in the table, as there is always the chance for more than one person to have the same name.

主键是表中的一个字段，可以唯一地识别表中的记录。

主键的主要特点。

  • 它必须为每一行包含一个**的唯一值。
  • 它不能包含NULL值。

例如，我们的表包含一个电话簿中每个名字的记录。唯一的**ID **号将是该表主键的一个很好的选择，因为总是有机会让不止一个人拥有相同的名字。

content.text:
- 每个表只能有**一个**主键。
- 主键值对每一行必须**唯一**。
content.text_html:
• Tables are limited to **ONE **primary key each.

  • The primary key's value must be different for each row.

  • 每个表只能有个主键。

  • 主键的值对每一行都必须是不同的。

resolved.title: 什么是SQL ？
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]What is SQL?[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Once you understand what a database is, understanding SQL is easy. [b]SQL [/b]stands for [b]S[/b]tructured [b]Q[/b]uery [b]L[/b]anguage.

[b]SQL [/b]is used to access and manipulate a [b]database[/b]. 
[b]MySQL[/b] is a [b]program[/b] that understands [b]SQL[/b].

SQL can:
 - insert, update, or delete records in a database.
 - create new databases, tables, stored procedures and views. 
 - retrieve data from a database, etc.
[note]SQL is an ANSI (American National Standards Institute) standard, but there are different versions of the SQL language.
Most SQL database programs have their own proprietary extensions in addition to the SQL standard, but all of them support the major commands.[/note]

content.text:
一旦你理解了什么是数据库，理解SQL就很容易了。
**SQL**全文为：**S**tructured **Q**uery **L**anguage，即**结构化**的查询语言。

**SQL**语言可访问和操作**数据库**。

**MySQL**是一个能解析并执行**SQL**语言的开源数据库。

通过SQL可以：
 - 插入、更新、或删除数据库中的记录。
 - 创建数据库、表、存储过程和视图。
 - 从数据库中检索数据，等等。
content.text_html:
Once you understand what a database is, understanding SQL is easy. **SQL **stands for Structured Query Language.

**SQL **is used to access and manipulate a database. MySQL is a program that understands SQL.

SQL can:

  • insert, update, or delete records in a database.
  • create new databases, tables, stored procedures and views.
  • retrieve data from a database, etc.

一旦你理解了什么是数据库，理解SQL就很容易了。SQL 代表S结构化的Query L语言。

SQL 用于访问和操作数据库。 MySQL是一个能够理解SQL的**程序。

SQL可以。

  • 插入、更新、或删除数据库中的记录。
  • 创建新的数据库、表、存储过程和视图。
  • 从数据库中检索数据，等等。

content.text:
**SQL**是一个ANSI（美国国家标准协会）标准，但有不同版本的SQL语言。
大多数数据库程序在SQL标准之外还有自己专有的语言扩展，但基本不同的数据库程序都支持主要的SQL命令。
